tree_hash_definition.description: Enumerate regular files and symlink entries under the candidate root without following directory symlinks. Normalize each relative path to Unicode NFC with forward slashes. Hash each regular file's raw bytes with SHA-256; hash each symlink as SHA-256(bytes 'SYMLINK' + 0x00 + UTF-8 link target). Sort records by normalized relative path using ordinal Unicode order. The tree digest is SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of each path, NUL, lowercase per-entry SHA-256 hex, LF, concatenated in sorted order. Empty directories are not represented.
tree_hash_definition.exclusion_rule: Exclude only directory names in the list above, which are VCS metadata, dependency caches, generated build output, test caches, or local runtime/cache state. No source file was excluded. Exclusions present in a particular hashed tree are listed in that candidate's provenance_notes.
